Piscinola, Scampia, Marianella, Chiaiano (Municipalità 8) — Naples, Italy

In detail

Scampia is internationally known through "Gomorrah" as a centre of organised crime, and it is named among the five zones most affected by the 92 stese recorded across Naples in 2024. The demolition of the last of the notorious "Vele di Scampia" towers was completed in February 2025, with mayor Gaetano Manfredi stating publicly "non è più Gomorra" (it isn't Gomorrah any more) — a genuine and significant milestone, paired with the same 2025 government-backed regeneration plan covering Secondigliano. That statement is an aspiration for where the area is heading, not yet a confirmed change in the current crime pattern, so the night rating here stays red pending evidence the improvement has actually taken hold. Sources checked: Napolitan.it, 13 Apr 2025 (92 stese in 2024, zones named); TGCOM24, Feb 2025 (Vele di Scampia demolition completed, mayor Manfredi's statement); RecoverWeb.it (Vele di Scampia demolition and regeneration).
